description: Let the business run, then set the jug down.
name: Alice Brambleby

description: Left the carrier as an old bill, not a new one.
name: George Bryan

description: Wanted the doors open on the days just written.
name: James Burbage

description: Said fourteen once, and read the bills.
name: John Heminges

description: Kept her stair out of the fourteen.
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: Kept you out of Friday's king.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Sat wet from the bolster, and refused a second reckoning.
name: Thomas Pope

description: His hand is on the cup. He is not drinking.
name: Will Kemp
